rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing
rules.quote: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord. It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.summary: San Diego prohibits landlords from using algorithmic devices that use nonpublic competitor data to set rental rates or occupancy levels, and prohibits selling or licensing such devices to landlords.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to residential rental property in the City of San Diego
rules.exemption_note: Does not include software used to publish reports from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old or from publicly available information without recommending future rates; or software used to establish rental rates per affordable housing program guidelines.
rules.penalty: Tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation. Each month a violation continues and each residential rental property where an algorithmic device is used constitutes a separate violation. Prevailing tenant recovers costs and reasonable attorney's fees.
